tools.description: List, enable, disable, or inspect trading strategies in Strategy Hub.

tools.name: select_strategy_exchange
tools.description: Select a connected execution environment on an inactive saved private draft without creating a draft or starting an order. Runnable saved-draft venues are disclosed separately; connected does not mean live-runnable.

tools.name: run_saved_strategy
tools.description: Start an already selected saved private draft only through its verified Paper or WhiteBIT runner. Requires confirm=true and, on WHITEBIT, accept_managed_tp_risk=true. A connected API key alone is not a runner.

tools.name: start_paper_strategy
tools.description: Start a saved draft in the verified paper runner only. Requires an exact matching backtest and confirm=true. Never places an exchange order.

tools.name: update_strategy_exchange
tools.description: Change only an already running strategy's exchange and consistent spot/futures fields. Spot forces 1x. dry_run previews without saving. No draft, status change, or exchange order.

tools.name: update_strategy_rules
tools.description: Overwrite an existing saved draft's rules in place. Omitting TRAILING STOP from exitRules, or setting trailingStopPercent to null, 0, or none, removes it. dry_run previews without saving. Refuses absent drafts.

tools.name: account_risk_settings
tools.description: Read or update only the authenticated account's risk settings with an agent token; dry_run validates an update without saving.

tools.name: implement_strategy
tools.description: Save a structured strategy draft privately to Strategy Hub, inactive. Does not write code or enable trading. Requires confirm=true.

tools.name: strategy_hub
